reports.summary: We secured a hard-fought victory by maintaining steady pressure across the front, adapting to blocked advances, and exploiting gaps in enemy lines during the middle game. Our forces held key terrain and transitioned smoothly from movement to engagement as opportunities arose.

As the Verdant commander, I advanced aggressively with scouts and melee units to disrupt Crimson’s formations. Early scouting revealed enemy positions, and I committed to sustained attacks on key enemy squads. Despite inflicting heavy losses, Crimson’s resilience and superior positioning ultimately secured their victory. My forces were eliminated by Turn 12.

Amber failed to issue orders on turn 3, losing coordination and initiative. Later turns saw successful attacks that destroyed an enemy squad, but the early lapse prevented a decisive advantage and Crimson ultimately prevailed.
